title: Interventions in a learned neural auction mechanism shift outcomes in both directions
summary: The study reports intervention effects in both directions alongside fidelity checks and comparisons to known mechanism regions and auction-theory expectations. Results are specific to the evaluated learned mechanisms and interventions; they do not establish general causal explanations for real-world auctions.
ai_technology: Sparse autoencoder features were extracted from a learned auction mechanism and intervened on to examine effects on mechanism outputs.
